subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: When reconciling the Sales Ledger Control Account balance with the schedule of individual debtors, it was discovered that a customer's debit balance of ₦1,500 was entirely omitted from the schedule (list of debtors). To reconcile the records, the accountant must:
options: Add ₦1,500 to the Sales Ledger Control Account balance
Deduct ₦1,500 from the Sales Ledger Control Account balance
Add ₦1,500 to the total of the schedule of debtors
Debit the Sales Day Book with ₦1,500
questions.explain:
Reconciliation involves correcting whichever side the error occurred on. 

Since the omission was strictly from the **schedule (list) of individual debtors** (meaning the individual's ledger balance wasn't copied to the list), the control account itself is already correct. Therefore, the correction is simply to **add the omitted ₦1,500 back to the total of the schedule** so that it agrees with the control account balance.
